title: OpenAI starts to hedge its bets beyond Nvidia
hook: 你看見賭桌上，一個賭客的籌碼幾乎全堆在同一格，手裡還捏著一枚。
bridge: 賭客把籌碼分開後，你回頭一看，另一個蹺蹺板正歪向重的那一邊。
p: TensorWave said this week that it will supply OpenAI with 457 megawatts of computing power across several U.S. data center sites, Fortune reported. It is the first neocloud tied to OpenAI's October deal with AMD, which covers 6 gigawatts, and the capacity is expected in the first half of 2027. With that deal, OpenAI looks to be {0}.

The 457 megawatts equal about 7.6% of the AMD deal, and TensorWave says it is its largest deployment ever. A source told Fortune that OpenAI's models still run almost entirely on Nvidia GPUs, a {1} arrangement, even as the company designs its own chip, Jalapeño, with Broadcom.

words.def: to reduce the risk of losing by supporting more than one option
words.mn: 賭桌上，OpenAI 的籌碼幾乎全堆在 NVDA 那一格，這回它把一枚黃色籌碼挪到 AMD 那格。兩格都押，就是分散風險。
words.ex: She kept her old job while hedging her bets with a small startup.
words.exZh: 她保留原本的工作，同時在一間小新創上兩邊下注。

quiz.q: The investor refused to put everything in one stock and chose to ___ across several funds.
quiz.why: hedge one's bets 是分散風險。burn bridges 是斷絕後路，jump the gun 是操之過急。

quiz.q: The match felt ___ because one team had twice as many players.
quiz.why: lopsided 是一面倒、失衡。seamless 是無縫順暢，airtight 是滴水不漏。
